newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow, $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow, $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers were $1.00 per cwt lower than last Thursday, instances $2.00 lower and slaughter heifers were $1.00 lower.
Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed on 4,300 slaughter steers and 1,400 slaughter heifers Monday.
For the week to date, 16,700 head confirmed, including 10,200 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1020-1375 lbs, mostly 1150- 1200 lbs 68.00, several pens 67.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1050 lbs 68.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1360 lb heifers and heiferettes 65.50.
Wk to date - 16,700 last week - 6,000 last year - 3,400
